title: Blood on pillow after 1988 camping trip
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Blood on pillow after 1988 camping trip, about 1988 at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: his pillow. You did mention after the camping trip in 1988 you waking up with blood on your pillow,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, is interviewing Richard Barth, a man who guarded nuclear missiles and says he was abducted by aliens. Michels recalls Barth saying that after a camping trip in 1988 he woke up with blood on his pillow. The detail is told as a possible sign that something was done to him in the night.
